verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਈਬੇਦ ਕੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: hom jag nieebedh kai poojaa anek jap tap sa(n)jam anek pu(n)n dhaan kai ||

en.bdb: Performing ritualistic worships, making offerings to the gods, performing worship of many kinds, living life in penance and Strict discipline, making charity;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਵਨ ਭੂਅ ਹਿਮਾਚਲ ਧਾਰਾ ਅਗ੍ਰ ਅਰਪਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jal thal gir tar teerath bhavan bhooa himaachal dhaaraa agr arapan praan kai ||

en.bdb: Roaming in deserts, water bodies mountains, places of pilgrimage and wasteland, giving up life while approaching the snow clad summits of Himalaya;

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਸਾਅੰਗੀਤ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਬਹੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: raag naadh baadh saa(n)geet bedh paaTh bahu sahaj samaadh saadh koT jog dhiaan kai ||

en.bdb: Performing recitation of Vedas, singing in modes to the accompaniment of musical instruments, practicing obstinate exercises of Yoga, and indulging in millions of contemplations of Yogic discipline;

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਉ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਹਠ ਜਤਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੈ ॥੨੫੫॥
verses.translit_en: charan saran gur sikh saadh sa(n)g par vaar ddaarau nigreh haTh jatan koTaan kai ||255||

en.bdb: Abstaining the senses from vices and trying other obstinate practices of Yoga, all this is sacrificed by a Guru-conscious person over the company of saintly persons and the refuge of the True Guru. All these practices are trivial and inane. (255)
